title: A fresh look for meetings and Home

items.text: MatterMeet and the Home page have a fresh look, with new backgrounds, your own picture behind you and fun face effects.
Profile pictures now show on meeting tiles, in People and across MatterChat.
Meeting notes can be emailed to the people from your firm who came, and captions can read in your language.
Threads read like Slack, menus and colours are easier to use in every look, and lots of small improvements.
